mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_comment WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_comment SET status=#{state},body=IF(#{state2}='DELETED','',body),version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id,author_id,note_id,root_id,reply_to_id,IF(status='VISIBLE',body,'该评论已不可见') AS body,status,created_at FROM t_comment WHERE note_id=#{note} AND root_id IS NULL AND id<#{before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT id,author_id,note_id,root_id,reply_to_id,IF(status='VISIBLE',body,'该回复已不可见') AS body,status,created_at FROM t_comment WHERE note_id=#{note} AND root_id=#{root} AND id<#{before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_comment c JOIN t_note n ON n.id=c.note_id WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.status='VISIBLE' AND n.status='PUBLISHED'
